stories.author: louiereederson
bullet_points: Major AI players (Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta) are actively lobbying against excessive regulation of open-weight AI models.
The industry leaders are advocating for a balanced approach to regulation to foster innovation while managing risks.
The discussion centers on the tension between promoting open-source AI development and implementing necessary safety guardrails.

This represents a critical and severe security vulnerability in consumer IoT devices.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to a 90% speed increase, as validated by the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance boost results in faster response times and reduced memory usage for models.
The updated engine also contributes to higher quality outputs from the language models.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, offering an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these agents can run entirely on the user's local hardware.
It integrates native support with Ollama, facilitating local LLM deployment.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
The integration leverages MLX, Apple's native machine learning framework, specifically for Apple Silicon.
This preview aims to provide the fastest possible local LLM execution experience on Apple hardware.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging applications with local AI coding agents.
The core feature emphasizes running AI entirely on the user's own device for privacy/control.

stories.title: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
stories.author: David Pierce
bullet_points: The traditional symbiotic relationship between Google and the web is reportedly changing.
Google's data collection and traffic distribution model is facing disruption.
The shift signals a potential fundamental change in how the internet operates and monetizes content.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
stories.author: Hayden Field
bullet_points: Anthropic has released its new large language model, Claude Opus 5.
The company claims Opus 5 approaches the capabilities of the yet-to-be-released Claude Fable 5.
The release follows recent high-profile events in the AI space, including government interactions and an OpenAI security incident.

stories.title: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Meta is enhancing its AI chatbot to function more like a personal assistant.
Key new features include calendar integration for event planning and daily briefing generation.
The update aims to boost Meta AI's competitiveness against rivals like Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude.

stories.title: This is the world's most advanced robotic servicing satellite—that we know about
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: The article discusses a highly advanced robotic servicing satellite.
The technology represents a significant achievement in complex space engineering.
The development addresses inherently difficult challenges in space operations.

stories.title: Forgot your Google password? Now you can log in with a selfie.
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google is integrating selfie videos as a new method for account access and password recovery.
The technology supports multiple use cases beyond login, including AI Avatar creation.
The feature also incorporates age verification capabilities, raising privacy and security discussions.

stories.title: 3D-Aware VLMs with Implicit and Explicit Geometries
stories.author: Gongjie Zhang
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in handling complex 3D spatial reasoning tasks.
Introduces VLM-IE3D, a unified framework that integrates both implicit and explicit 3D geometries derived from RGB videos.
Employs Implicit Geometry Tokens (IGTs) to inject high-level geometric priors into the VLM architecture.

stories.title: GraphVid: Interactive Graph-Controllable Video Generation
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: Introduces GraphVid, a new method for controllable video generation.
Addresses the limitation of current methods in precisely controlling complex, multi-object interactions in video.
Uses a graph-based approach to enable flexible and precise control over multiple subjects, overcoming issues with trajectory drawing and occlusion.

stories.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
stories.author: Jianfeng Gao
bullet_points: Introduces OpenForgeRL, an open-source framework designed to train AI agents end-to-end.
Addresses the difficulty of training agents when relying on complex, proprietary inference harnesses (like Claude Code or Codex).
Enables training in diverse environments by natively supporting stateful, multi-process harness inference.

stories.title: 3D-Aware VLMs with Implicit and Explicit Geometries
stories.author: Gongjie Zhang
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in handling complex 3D spatial reasoning tasks.
Introduces VLM-IE3D, a unified framework that integrates both implicit and explicit 3D geometries into VLMs.
Employs Implicit Geometry Tokens (IGTs) to inject high-level geometric priors into the model's understanding.

stories.title: X$^3$-OPD: Distilling Reasoning into Large Audio-Language Models via On-Policy Alignment
stories.author: Tao Jin
bullet_points: Addresses the gap in deep logical reasoning within large audio-language models (LALMs) compared to text-based LLMs.
Introduces X$^3$-OPD, a cross-modal on-policy distillation framework.
The framework transfers advanced reasoning capabilities from a powerful text teacher model to an audio-language student model.

stories.title: DONDO: Open w2v-BERT Speech-Recognition Base Models for African Languages
stories.author: Paul Azunre
bullet_points: Introduction of DONDO, a family of open, permissively licensed ASR base models specifically for African languages.
The models utilize the w2v-BERT 2.0 self-supervised speech encoder and cover 27 language varieties across several African nations.
Training data primarily consists of read speech from religious texts, ensuring broad and license-clear usage.

stories.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
stories.author: Alagappan Valliappan
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical performance bottleneck in speculative decoding when dealing with extremely long contexts (million-tokens).
The issue arises because standard Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP) draft heads incur a quadratic or linear cost due to full attention over the growing KV cache.
The proposed 'Windowed-MTP' method aims to mitigate this 'Draft-KV Tax' by limiting the scope of the draft head's attention.

It enhances Ollama's MLX engine specifically for better performance on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for subagents within Claude Code.
The update also enables web search functionality within the Claude Code environment.
This enhances the capabilities of AI agents by adding modularity (subagents) and real-time information access (web search).

stories.title: Tesla’s car door defect could lead to tougher rules for everyone
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Tesla's electronic door handles have been linked to fatal incidents.
NHTSA has issued a notice regarding complaints about the mechanical door release.
The issue may prompt broader, tougher safety regulations across the automotive industry.

stories.title: Boox is taking on Xteink with its own tiny e-reader
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Boox is launching a new line of small e-readers called 'Tile' to compete with Xteink.
The first model, the Picco, features a 3.97-inch front-lit, black-and-white e-paper display.
The devices are designed to be small enough to attach to devices like an iPhone using MagSafe and include SD card support.

stories.title: The tech-broification of American science has officially begun
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: The Trump administration launched the 'Genesis Mission,' allocating $5 billion to AI-driven science projects.
The initiative is framed by the White House as being comparable in scope to the Manhattan Project.
The announcement occurred alongside political lobbying efforts by the administration's science adviser.

stories.title: Rocket Report: Lightning strikes in China; Starship launch on deck
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: Relativity Space is expanding its manufacturing capabilities.
The company plans to construct a second rocket factory near Cape Canaveral, Florida.
The news is framed alongside updates regarding Starship launch preparations.

stories.title: AI firms want more data centers; Trump's EPA may give neighbors less say
stories.author: Molly Taft, wired.com
bullet_points: AI industry's growing demand for data centers is a key driver.
Proposed EPA rules could significantly limit public input on data center siting.
The regulatory shift grants states greater autonomy over environmental review processes.

stories.title: Robot snakes searched for Venezuela earthquake survivors in collapsed buildings
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: US robotics researchers deployed snakebots to search for survivors in Venezuela.
The deployment highlights the practical application of robotics in disaster relief scenarios.
The use of snake-like robots is suited for navigating collapsed and confined spaces.

stories.title: Microsoft responds to LG monitors installing McAfee ads on Windows
stories.author: Scharon Harding
bullet_points: Microsoft addressed an issue where McAfee advertisements were being installed on Windows PCs.
The unwanted McAfee installation was triggered when specific LG monitors were connected to a computer.
The installation mechanism was identified as occurring through Windows Update.

stories.title: AI Kill Switch Act would let Trump admin order shutdown of rogue AI systems
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: The proposed AI Kill Switch Act grants Homeland Security authority over rogue AI systems.
The legislation would allow the DHS chief to mandate the shutdown of specific AI technologies.
This represents a significant legislative attempt to regulate AI safety and control.

stories.title: Beyond Sufficiency: Time Series Explanation with Counterfactual Necessity
stories.author: Weiru Liu
bullet_points: Introduces TimePNS, a new framework for time-series explanation.
Addresses a limitation in existing methods by incorporating 'necessity' alongside 'sufficiency' in explanations.
Aims to prevent spurious subsequences from being over-weighted in black-box model interpretations.

stories.title: Beyond Sycophancy: Structured Resistance and Compliance in LLM Moral Reasoning
stories.author: Bernard Koch
bullet_points: The research addresses the limitation of simply reducing 'sycophancy' in LLMs.
It proposes that socially calibrated LLMs must learn to distinguish between incorporating external views and maintaining independent moral judgment.
The study identifies three structured dimensions governing how models revise their judgments based on external input.

stories.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
stories.author: Xuezhe Ma
bullet_points: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show inconsistent visual reasoning, even when equivalent information is presented in text, diagram, or combined formats.
The research highlights that different input views (text vs. visual) can elicit different behaviors in VLMs, suggesting limitations in their current reasoning capabilities.
The proposed 'MIRROR' method aims to leverage these complementary views to improve multi-modal reasoning in AI models.

stories.title: Beyond Sufficiency: Time Series Explanation with Counterfactual Necessity
stories.author: Weiru Liu
bullet_points: Introduces TimePNS, a new framework for explaining time-series classifiers.
Addresses a limitation in existing methods by incorporating 'necessity' alongside 'sufficiency' in explanations.
Aims to prevent spurious subsequences from being over-emphasized in model explanations, aligning with counterfactual reasoning.

stories.title: Graph Learning on Ensembles of Cyclic Peptides: An Investigation of Molecular Ensemble Modeling
stories.author: Maxim Secor
bullet_points: Introduces EnsembleEGNN, a foundation model designed to handle molecular conformational ensembles rather than single structures.
The model utilizes Equivariant Graph Neural Networks (EGNN) to encode individual conformers, followed by a Set Attention Block for ensemble pooling.
It is pre-trained on CREMP, a dataset focused on cyclic peptide ensembles, targeting molecular property prediction.

stories.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
stories.author: Xuezhe Ma
bullet_points: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show inconsistent reasoning capabilities across different input modalities (text vs. visual diagrams).
The study highlights that different views (text, diagram, combined) can elicit different behaviors in VLMs, even for equivalent problems.
The research proposes that these view-dependent inconsistencies suggest that different modalities expose complementary reasoning pathways.

stories.title: The Boundaries of Automation: A Theory of Persistent Human Participation
stories.author: Iryna Gurevych
bullet_points: The paper challenges the prevailing assumption that human involvement in AI is only necessary due to current AI limitations.
It shifts the focus from 'how far automation can extend' to identifying the conceptual limits of automation.
The research posits that human participation may remain necessary even when AI systems achieve high levels of capability.

stories.title: MedGame: Storytelling Gamification Empowered by Large Language Models for Medical Education
stories.author: Qi Dou
bullet_points: Introduces MedGame, a framework that uses LLMs to transform static clinical cases into interactive, decision-centered storytelling games for medical education.
Addresses a limitation in current LLM applications in medicine, moving beyond simple Q&A to create complex learning trajectories.
Features a dual-engine design, including a Medical Narrative Designer, to structure and execute the clinical case narratives.

stories.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
stories.author: Jianfeng Gao
bullet_points: Introduces OpenForgeRL, an open-source framework designed to train AI agents end-to-end.
Addresses the difficulty of training agents that rely on complex, proprietary inference harnesses (like Claude Code/Codex) using open infrastructure.
Enables the native expression of stateful, multi-process harness inference within open SFT/RL stacks.

stories.title: GS-Agent: Creating 4D Physical Worlds With Generative Simulation
stories.author: Chuang Gan
bullet_points: The research introduces GS-Agent to generate dynamic and physically realistic 4D worlds from natural language descriptions.
Current methods for generative simulation struggle with ensuring physical plausibility and controllability.
This work aims to automate the complex, manual process of creating detailed 3D/4D environments using generative foundation models.

stories.title: Artificial Epanorthosis: Why large language models overuse a classical rhetorical figure, and how to mitigate it
stories.author: Federico Boggia
bullet_points: LLMs exhibit a systematic overuse of 'epanorthosis,' a classical rhetorical self-correction technique.
The overuse is attributed to training data rich in promotional prose and RLHF tuning favoring emphatic phrasing.
The study suggests the left-to-right nature of LLM generation contributes to this rhetorical pattern.

stories.title: What, Where, and How: Disentangling the Roles of Task, Language, and Model in Code Model Representations
stories.author: Piotr Wilam
bullet_points: The research investigates how different language models (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and DeepSeek-Coder-V1-6.7B) represent code concepts across different programming languages (Python and Rust).
It employs a 2x2 design to disentangle the influence of the task, the specific language, and the underlying model architecture on code representation.
The study measures a comprehensive inventory of grammatical concepts to determine if independently trained models encode the same information identically.

stories.title: Agentic coding without the cloud: evaluating open-weight large language models on longitudinal data preparation tasks
stories.author: David Bann
bullet_points: Addresses the privacy constraint of using cloud-based LLMs for code development research involving sensitive data.
Proposes using locally deployable, open-weight LLMs as a solution to keep data within the local environment.
Introduces an open-source framework to evaluate the performance of AI agents on longitudinal data preparation tasks.

stories.title: India's first privately-developed rocket reaches orbit on dramatic debut launch
stories.author: sohkamyung
bullet_points: India achieved a significant milestone with its first privately-developed rocket reaching orbit.
The launch was described as a 'dramatic debut,' suggesting high public interest.
This marks a notable development in the private space technology sector within India.

stories.title: AI-Generated Code: Anatomy of Security Vulnerabilities and the Cost
stories.author: merbayerp
bullet_points: The article addresses security vulnerabilities found in AI-generated code.
It discusses the practical implications and costs associated with using AI code.
The topic is relevant to modern software development practices and AI integration.
